title: Stripe以70多亿美元收购OpenRouter，标志着向AI基础架构的转型
content:
Stripe has a new fintech playbook for the AI era.
Following the company's January purchase of the usage-based billing startup Metronome, the purchase of OpenRouter makes it clear that Stripe believes it can apply its payments-infrastructure approach to developer infrastructure.
"Stripe acquiring OpenRouter is less about buying a product and more about buying position," said Jeremy Jonker, managing partner at the fintech-focused firm Infinity Ventures. "For fintech more broadly, this is a signal that the next competitive battleground is around monetizing AI usage. The companies that win will be the ones sitting at the choke point between AI consumption and the invoice."
OpenRouter, which is backed by Andreessen Horowitz and Sequoia, reportedly sold for around $8 billion, though a formal purchase price was not disclosed.
The company is essentially an evolution of the business Stripe has already been running.
-       Instead of issuing cards or holding deposits, Stripe sits between businesses and the banks that do, taking a small percentage of each transaction.
-       OpenRouter is the same trade applied to inference. Sitting between developers and model providers, the startup connects the two, offering access to LLMs based on price, speed, and availability, charging a fraction of the inference spend it facilitates.

In a letter to investors obtained by Axios, Stripe acknowledged the parallels.
"It turns out that optimizing for developers, as Stripe has from the outset, is in many ways the same thing as optimizing for coding harnesses and for agents," the letter reads. "It's become evident to us that building economic infrastructure for the internet is mostly the same thing as building the economic infrastructure for AI."
Stripe isn't the only fintech making an AI infrastructure play. Ramp, a corporate expense management startup, just began offering Ramp Router, its own service that connects developers to major AI models.
Fintech dealmaking has remained healthy despite AI disruption, according to PitchBook data. Q2 deal value rose 28% from the previous quarter, hitting $13.3 billion netted from 461 deals.
For now, VCs see Stripe's AI infrastructure as the opening shot in a new battle to help developers manage AI spend. Those who don't adapt risk getting left behind.
"This should be a wake-up call," said Chris Sugden, managing partner at the growth equity firm Edison Partners. "Fintechs sometimes pigeonhole themselves into being just a payments company. This is a whole new way to think about fintech because this is not today's world we're going to be dealing with down the road."
This article originally appeared on PitchBook News

report.summary: Stripe收购OpenRouter布局AI基础设施，争夺AI使用计费入口。
report.background: Stripe是支付基础设施公司，传统上通过收取交易手续费盈利。2025年1月，它收购了基于用量计费的初创公司Metronome，如今又以约80亿美元收购AI模型聚合平台OpenRouter。OpenRouter连接开发者与多家大模型供应商，按价格、速度和可用性进行路由，并从推理消费中抽成。Stripe认为，为互联网建设经济基础设施与为AI建设经济基础设施本质相同。在AI代理和编码工具快速普及的背景下，金融科技公司正试图卡位AI消费和发票之间的关键节点。Ramp也推出了类似服务Ramp Router，风投视此为新一轮竞争的信号。
key_points: Stripe以约80亿美元收购AI模型聚合平台OpenRouter，未披露正式价格，加上此前收购Metronome，连续投资AI基础设施，意图明显。
OpenRouter如同AI界的Stripe：连接开发者和模型厂商，按价格、速度、可用性智能选路，并从推理消费中抽取分成，商业模式高度相似。
Stripe在投资函中表示，优化开发者体验与优化AI代理和编码工具是一致的，互联网经济基础设施与AI经济基础设施正在融合。
竞争加剧：Ramp推出Ramp Router，金融科技公司纷纷卡位AI使用量计费入口，避免在AI时代被边缘化。
风投指出这是金融科技的觉醒时刻，支付公司不能自我局限，而是要在AI消耗与账单之间打造新的咽喉要道。
report.impact: 对AI行业，支付巨头进入意味着AI服务商业化加速，模型聚合与计费层价值凸显，可能重塑AI产业链利润分配。对开发者，多模型访问和统一计费更便捷，但中间商抽成可能抬高成本，需关注定价透明度。对普通用户，AI应用会更快成熟，但底层成本可能以某种形式转嫁，最终取决于竞争格局。
report.tools: 开发者可浏览OpenRouter官网体验多模型路由；跟踪Strike的AI计费API及Metronome产品；可关注开源替代LiteLLM和Portkey，它们提供类似的多模型网关、负载均衡与用量追踪能力，适合自建基础设施。
